compass-native-review.description: Compass Decisions provide tracking-only review requests and immutable decision history, Compass Docs hold supporting artifacts, and Geode runs and notifies.

geode-obsidian-review.description: Geode runs scheduled flows and notifications; Obsidian holds review requests and decision receipts; repository previews hold prototypes.

local-markdown-review.description: A local scheduled-agent runtime uses Markdown review files, local notifications, repository previews, and manually supplied analytics.
